paite: Obadiah mengmuhna Toupa PATHIAN in Edom tungtang ah hichi in achi: TOUPA a kipan thu ka thei a, namte lak ah palai sawl ahi, "Thou unla, kidouna ah amah dou ding in i kuan ding uh," chi in.
heading: Obadiah Mengmuhna, TOUPA'N Edom Agawt Ding
english: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord Yahweh says about Edom. We have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let’s rise up against her in battle.

paite: "Ngai dih, namte lak ah ka hon hihneuta hi; nakpi a muhsit in na omta.
english: Behold, I have made you small among the nations. You are greatly despised.

paite: Aw nang, suangpi kitam kal a teng, mun sang luah, kua'n ahia lei a hon kesak ding lungsim a chipa? Na lungtang kisaktheihna in nang ahon khemta hi.
english: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’

paite: Muvanlai bang in sangpi ah lengtou mah lechin, na bu leng aksi lak ah seh in om mahleh, huai a kipan ka hon kaikhesuk ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Na kiang ah gutate, suamhatte zan in hong pai le uh, hihman nak hih na ni chia, adeihzah un agu kei ding ua hia? Na kiang ah grep lakhawm mite hong pai le uh, grep lak ding khenkhatte anuse kei ding ua hia?
english: “If thieves came to you, if robbers by night—oh, what disaster awaits you—wouldn’t they only steal until they had enough? If grape pickers came to you, wouldn’t they leave some gleaning grapes?

paite: Esau thilte zonkhiak ahita a; agoubawm selgukte maikhiak ahita!
english: How Esau will be ransacked! How his hidden treasures are sought out!

paite: Nang lawmte khem in na om a, gamgi pha in hon delhkhe ding ua; na kituahpihte'n nang ahon zouta ua; na tanghou nete'n na nuai ah thang akam ua; amah ah theihsiamna a-om kei hi.
english: All the men of your alliance have brought you on your way, even to the border. The men who were at peace with you have deceived you, and prevailed against you. Friends who eat your bread lay a snare under you. There is no understanding in him.”

paite: Huai ni chiang in Edom a kipan mipilte ka hihmang in, Esau tang a kipan theihsiamna ka hihmang kei dia hia?" TOUPA'N achi hi.
english: “Won’t I in that day”, says Yahweh, “destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mountain of Esau?

paite: Aw Teman, Esau tang ah michih thahgam a a-om vekna ding ua, na mihatte nakpitak in alunglel ding uh.
english: Your mighty men, Teman, will be dismayed, to the end that everyone may be cut off from the mountain of Esau by slaughter.

paite: "Na unaupa Jakob tung a na hiamgamna ziak in zumna in nang ahon khuh ding, tangtawn in hihmanthat in na om ding hi.
heading: Edom Gawt A Om Ziak
english: For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.

paite: Langkhat a na din ni a, mikhualte'n asum alakmang ni ua, namdang mite akulh kongkhak a ahong lut ua, Jerusalem tung a ai asan lai un, nang leng amau lak a tel bang in na om hi.
english: In the day that you stood on the other side, in the day that strangers carried away his substance and foreigners entered into his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, even you were like one of them.

paite: Himahleh na unaupa asiat lai in awibawl ke'nla, Judah tate amanthat ni un kipak ke'n; ahaksat ni in kisatheitak in pau ke'n.
english: But don’t look down on your brother in the day of his disaster, and don’t rejoice over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction. Don’t speak proudly in the day of distress.

paite: Ka mite avangsiat ni un akulh kongpi uah lut ke'nla; avangsiat ni un athuakna uh en ke'n, avangsiat ni un asum-le-paite uh tung ah na khutte uh nga sam kei un.
english: Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of their calamity, neither seize their wealth on the day of their calamity.

paite: Ami khenkhat taikhete that ding in lamka thuam a dingh in, haksat ni in ami omsunte mansak ke'n.
english: Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day of distress.

paite: Nam tengteng tung ah TOUPA ni lah anai ngal a; na hihsiat mah bang in na tung ah hih ahi ding; na hihdan nangmah luzang ah hong kik ding hi.
heading: Namte Tung A Thukhenna
english: For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.

paite: Ka tang siangthou a na dawn bang un, nam tengteng in adawn gige ding uh, ahi, adawn ding ua, avalh ding ua, piang lou bang in a-om ding uh.
english: For as you have drunk on my holy mountain, so all the nations will drink continually. Yes, they will drink, swallow down, and will be as though they had not been.

paite: Zion tang ah bel suaktate a-om ding ua, asiangthou ding uh; Jakob inkote'n agoutante uh atang ding uhi.
heading: Israelte Vualzohna
english: But in Mount Zion, there will be those who escape, and it will be holy. The house of Jacob will possess their possessions.

paite: Jakob inkote mei ahi ding ua, Joseph inkote meikuang ahi ding, Esau inkote buhpawl ahi ding ua, amau lak ah akuang ding ua, akangmang ding uh; Esau inkote khosuak a-om kei ding uh; TOUPA'N lah achita ngal hi.
english: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble. They will burn among them and devour them. There will not be any remaining to the house of Esau.” Indeed, Yahweh has spoken.

paite: Simlam mite'n Esau mual atang ding a; phaizang mite'n Philistia atang ding uh; amaute'n Ephraim leh Samaria lou atang ding uh; Benjamin in Gilead gam atang ding hi.
english: Those of the South will possess the mountain of Esau, and those of the lowland, the Philistines. They will possess the field of Ephraim, and the field of Samaria. Benjamin will possess Gilead.

paite: Kanaan mite lak a hiai Israel suan saltang mipite'n Zarephath gam tan atang ding ua; Sepharad gam a Jerusalem khomite saltang in simlam khopite atang ding uhi.
english: The captives of this army of the children of Israel, who are among the Canaanites, will possess even to Zarephath; and the captives of Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will possess the cities of the Negev.

paite: Zion tang a pan Esau dou ding in akuantou ding ua, atung ah vai ahawm ding uhi; huan gam TOUPA a ah i ding hi.”
english: Saviors will go up on Mount Zion to judge the mountains of Esau, and the kingdom will be Yahweh’s.
